title: A Pastor's Offering to God of Holy People
description: This sermon emphasizes the importance of pastors exalting and boasting in Christ's work through them to prepare a holy and obedient people for God. It highlights the need for pastors to rely on God's grace and the Holy Spirit's sanctifying work. Surprisingly, the congregation is also called to exhort, instruct, and admonish one another, showing the collaborative effort in building up the church.
